end.summary:
Practised finding partners that make 100.
Used tens and smaller jumps on a number line.
Answered 30 + 70 and 65 + 35 correctly without help.
Number-line jumps were not consistently explained or counted accurately.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Vihaan practised making 100 with tens and two-digit numbers, using number-line jumps and breaking numbers into parts. They answered the partner pairs correctly when solving directly. They mixed up how to count jumps and explain the method; this was not fully corrected by the end. At home, practise pairs such as 87 + 13 and 48 + 52 by drawing a number line and counting each jump aloud.
